name: Patient Optimist
source: Ultimate Campaign pg. 64, Cheliax, Empire of Devils pg. 19, Advanced Player's Guide pg. 333
body:
Drawbacks
Patient Optimist
Source Ultimate Campaign pg. 64, Cheliax, Empire of Devils pg. 19, Advanced Player's Guide pg. 333
Category Religion
Requirement(s) Erastil
You know that all things pass in time, and are used to having to repeat arguments multiple times to convince stubborn believers. You gain a +2 trait bonus on Diplomacy checks to influence hostile or unfriendly creatures, and if you fail at such an attempt, you may retry it once.
